question: Among players born before 1985 who are under 180 cm tall, find those whose most recent overall rating is above the average overall rating across all attribute records of players born before 1985. Return their names in descending order of that most recent overall rating.

prediction.sql:
WITH avg_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS avg_overall
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985
),
recent_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
        pa."XCL_132" AS overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p."XCL_122" ORDER BY pa."XCL_131" DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND p."XCL_126" < 180
)
SELECT rr.player_name
FROM recent_ratings rr
CROSS JOIN avg_rating ar
WHERE rr.rn = 1 AND rr.overall_rating > ar.avg_overall
ORDER BY rr.overall_rating DESC

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH avg_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS avg_overall
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985
),
recent_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
        pa."XCL_132" AS overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p."XCL_122" ORDER BY pa."XCL_131" DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND p."XCL_126" < 180
)
SELECT rr.player_name
FROM recent_ratings rr
CROSS JOIN avg_rating ar
WHERE rr.rn = 1 AND rr.overall_rating > ar.avg_overall
ORDER BY rr.overall_rating DESC

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH avg_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS avg_overall
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985
),
recent_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
        pa."XCL_132" AS overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p."XCL_122" ORDER BY pa."XCL_131" DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND p."XCL_126" < 180
)
SELECT rr.player_name
FROM recent_ratings rr
CROSS JOIN avg_rating ar
WHERE rr.rn = 1 AND rr.overall_rating > ar.avg_overall
ORDER BY rr.overall_rating DESC

    SELECT AVG(pa."XCL_138") AS avg_overall
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985
),
recent_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
        pa."XCL_138" AS overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p."XCL_122" ORDER BY pa."XCL_131" DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE CAST(substr(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND p."XCL_126" < 180
)
SELECT rr.player_name
FROM recent_ratings rr
CROSS JOIN avg_rating ar
WHERE rr.rn = 1 AND rr.overall_rating > ar.avg_overall

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH 
-- 1. Identify players born before 1985 and under 180 cm
eligible_players AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id,
        p.XCL_123 AS player_name
    FROM Player p
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 1985 
      AND p.XCL_127 < 180
),
-- 2. Calculate the average overall rating across ALL attribute records of players born before 1985
avg_rating_1985 AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(pa.XCL_132) AS avg_overall
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
    WHERE p.XCL_126 < 1985
),
-- 3. Find the most recent overall rating for each eligible player
recent_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        ep.player_id,
        ep.player_name,
        pa.XCL_132 AS most_recent_overall,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.XCL_130 ORDER BY pa.XCL_131 DESC) AS rn
    FROM eligible_players ep
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON ep.player_id = pa.XCL_130
)
-- 4. Filter for those with most recent rating > average and order by rating DESC
SELECT 
    rr.player_name
FROM recent_ratings rr
CROSS JOIN avg_rating_1985 ar
WHERE rr.rn = 1 
  AND rr.most_recent_overall > ar.avg_overall
ORDER BY rr.most_recent_overall DESC
